decisions.name: Header pointing readers to the author's own earlier post
decisions.audit_reason: Assesses whether the story is self-contained and parses without outside material; a comprehensibility craft property.
decisions.upstream_parent: Whether this entry is a fresh top-level reply or a continuation of the author's own earlier reply or post.

decisions.name: Revision-trail disclosure
decisions.audit_reason: Flags visible edit/revision notes; submission-process artifacts, not evidence of the story's quality.
decisions.upstream_parent: How long after the prompt appeared the story was written

decisions.name: Prior-thread reaction
decisions.audit_reason: Flags framing that positions the story relative to other thread responses; audience/thread awareness, not quality.
decisions.upstream_parent: Whether other replies already existed that this one reacts to or differentiates itself from

decisions.name: Audience-facing aftercare
decisions.audit_reason: Explicitly scores submission-stage behavior (notes, word counts, feedback asks), not the story's quality.
decisions.upstream_parent: Whether the item was posted as a standalone thread reply for an established reply audience

decisions.name: Thread-context references
decisions.audit_reason: Counts references to the prompt board/thread/other posts; platform context, not story quality.
decisions.upstream_parent: Whether other replies already existed that this one was reacting to

decisions.name: Prefatory note or restated tag before the narrative begins
decisions.audit_reason: Detects prompt-referencing framing lines before the story starts; platform furniture, not narrative craft.
decisions.upstream_parent: how long after the prompt appeared the story was written (and therefore how much time the writer had)

decisions.name: No read-through pass: inconsistencies a reread would catch
decisions.audit_reason: Counts internal inconsistencies (names, tense, dropped words); direct evidence of careful craft and editing.
decisions.upstream_parent: Length of the composition window between the prompt appearing and the reply being posted, and whether there was time for a reread before submitting.

decisions.name: Retrofitted-work markers
decisions.audit_reason: Flags whether text predates the prompt; a provenance/timing fingerprint, not evidence of narrative quality.
decisions.upstream_parent: Whether the story was retrofitted from material the author already had

decisions.name: Story ends without narrative resolution (cliffhanger/mid-arc cutoff)
decisions.audit_reason: Checks narrative resolution/closure, a structural craft property editors weigh when judging story quality.
decisions.upstream_parent: how long after the prompt appeared the story was written (and therefore how much time the writer had)

decisions.name: Compressed submission form
decisions.audit_reason: Reads formatting as evidence of a rushed writing/posting window; a fingerprint of when, not quality.
decisions.upstream_parent: How long after the prompt appeared the story was written
